sources.title: Naga City Tourism: San Francisco Church
sources.note: Supports the facts listed here; historical events do not date the current mapped geometry.

text.en: Franciscan missionaries established the church in 1578, initially using light materials.
Fray Geronimo de Aguilar was its first priest.
Spanish forces made their final stand here in September 1898 against revolutionaries led by Elias Angeles and Felix Plazo.
The church faces Plaza Quince Martires in downtown Naga.
